test_process_manager_normal_shutdown: test that multiple processes managed by ProcessManager terminate normally without errors
test_process_manager_crash_handling: test that ProcessManager correctly detects and reports process crashes at any lifecycle phase
test_process_manager_exception_handling: test that ProcessManager correctly detects and reports exceptions raised by managed processes
test_process_manager_hang_handling: test that ProcessManager correctly detects and kills processes that hang at any phase
run_child_main_subprocess: run the child_main click CLI to simulate a managed subprocess with a given shutdown behavior
